# T-424 — `reference/asset-providers/SKILL.md` auto-generated catalog

**Branch**: `task/T-424-asset-providers-catalog`

## Goal

Add a new auto-generated reference SKILL at
`skills/stageflip/reference/asset-providers/SKILL.md` that walks the
`AdapterRegistry` (from `@stageflip/adapters-core`, T-418) and renders
the registered adapters as a markdown catalog table. Columns:

| Column | Source |
|---|---|
| Adapter ID | `descriptor.id` |
| Modality | `descriptor.modality.kind` |
| Capability summary | one-line per modality (per ADR-008 §D6) — derived from `descriptor.capability` |
| License | `descriptor.license.kind` |
| Cost tier | derived from `descriptor.costPerCall` (`free` / `paid` / `enterprise` / `unspecified`) |
| Latency tier | derived from `descriptor.latencyMs.p95` (`interactive < 1s` / `fast < 10s` / `batch < 5min` / `async ≥ 5min` / `unspecified`) |
| `requiresResearchProvider` | `yes` / `no` (truthy on `descriptor.requiresResearchProvider` OR `descriptor.sourceGrounded`) |

The inaugural state is **empty** — the registry is created at sync-skills
time and no production adapters register. The committed SKILL says
"0 adapters currently registered" and reserves the table headers for
when T-426..T-434 land.

T-424 is M-sized: small library extension to `@stageflip/skills-sync`,
new auto-gen entry in `scripts/sync-skills.ts`, inaugural empty SKILL on
disk. Mirrors the existing six generator entries (`reference/schema`,
`reference/validation-rules`, `clips/catalog`, `tools/index`,
`runtimes/index`, `reference/cli`) verbatim in shape.

## Dependencies

**Required reading (in order)**:

1. `docs/decisions/ADR-007-provider-seam-pattern.md` §D1 — `AdapterDescriptor` source-of-truth.
2. `docs/decisions/ADR-008-asset-generation.md` §D6 (per-modality capability shapes) + §D13 (per-modality license rules).
3. `packages/adapters-core/src/adapter-descriptor.ts` — `AdapterDescriptor`, `AdapterModality`, `AdapterLicensePosture`, `CostHint`, `LatencyHint`.
4. `packages/adapters-core/src/registry.ts` — `AdapterRegistry` (the iteration target).
5. `packages/skills-sync/src/runtimes-index-gen.ts` + `runtimes-index-gen.test.ts` — closest existing generator; mirror frontmatter shape, table rendering, and intro copy.
6. `packages/skills-sync/src/index.ts` — re-export site for new generators.
7. `scripts/sync-skills.ts` — dispatch list; T-424 appends an entry following the runtimes-index pattern.
8. `skills/stageflip/reference/cli/SKILL.md` (frontmatter only) — auto-generated frontmatter convention (`status: auto-generated`, `tier: reference`, `last_updated`, `owner_task`).

**Predecessor tasks merged on `main`**:

- T-415 — ADR-007 Provider Seam.
- T-416 — ADR-008 Asset Generation.
- T-418 — `@stageflip/adapters-core` (the registry T-424 walks).
- T-419..T-423 — Phase 14 α infra (descriptors / cache / schema / license-gate / handler bundle).
- T-220 — generator pattern T-424 mirrors.

## Out of scope

| Item | Why deferred |
|---|---|
| Concrete reference adapter registrations | T-426..T-434 land per-adapter; each adds itself to the registry-population step in `scripts/sync-skills.ts` so the inaugural empty state automatically populates. |
| Per-tenant license-posture filtering inside the catalog | The catalog is the **vendor-neutral** reference; tenant-side filtering happens in the routing engine (T-425). |
| Capability-shape parsing (rendering full `CapabilityDescriptor` envelopes) | T-424 emits a one-line summary per modality. Full per-call shapes live in `tools/asset-generation/SKILL.md` (T-423). |
| Auto-gen from package metadata (e.g., reading `package.json` to scaffold the table) | The registry IS the source of truth; this task does not introduce filesystem walking of `packages/`. |
| Schema / parity-cli / clip / preset / parity-golden changes | All untouched. |

## Acceptance criteria

1. `packages/skills-sync/src/asset-providers-gen.ts` exports `generateAssetProvidersSkill(pkg: AssetProvidersPkg): string` and the `AssetProvidersPkg` / `AssetProvidersAdapterRow` types. The function is **pure** — same input → same output byte-for-byte.
2. The generator emits valid frontmatter:
   ```
   ---
   title: Reference — Asset Providers
   id: skills/stageflip/reference/asset-providers
   tier: reference
   status: auto-generated
   last_updated: 2026-05-11
   owner_task: T-424
   related:
     - skills/stageflip/concepts/provider-seam
     - skills/stageflip/tools/asset-generation
   ---
   ```
3. The body contains an "auto-generated; do NOT edit by hand" warning citing `pnpm skills-sync` and `pnpm skills-sync:check`.
4. With **0 adapters**, the body contains the literal sentence "0 adapters currently registered" and a follow-up note that T-426..T-434 will populate the catalog. The table headers are still rendered (so the empty state is unambiguous about the schema).
5. With **N>0 adapters**, the body contains a markdown table whose rows are sorted by `(modality.kind ASC, id ASC)`. Each row exposes the seven columns named in the Goal section.
6. The `Capability summary` column dispatches per `modality.kind` to a one-line summary derived from the opaque `capability` envelope. The dispatch covers all 15 modality kinds enumerated in `ADAPTER_MODALITY_KINDS`. Unknown / malformed capability shapes degrade gracefully to the literal `—` (em dash) — they never throw.
7. The `Cost tier` derivation:
   - `costPerCall` undefined → `unspecified`
   - `costPerCall.usd === 0` (or absent and `tokensIn === 0 && tokensOut === 0`) → `free`
   - `costPerCall.usd ≤ 0.10` → `paid`
   - `costPerCall.usd > 0.10` → `enterprise`
   The thresholds are documented in the generator source (TSDoc) and tested.
8. The `Latency tier` derivation (using `latencyMs.p95` when present, else `latencyMs.p50`):
   - undefined → `unspecified`
   - `< 1000` → `interactive < 1s`
   - `< 10000` → `fast < 10s`
   - `< 300000` → `batch < 5min`
   - `≥ 300000` → `async`
   Documented in TSDoc and tested.
9. The `requiresResearchProvider` column emits `yes` when EITHER `descriptor.requiresResearchProvider` is a non-empty string OR `descriptor.sourceGrounded === true`. Otherwise `no`.
10. The generator is wired into `scripts/sync-skills.ts` as a 7th entry, named `'reference/asset-providers'`, targeting `skills/stageflip/reference/asset-providers/SKILL.md`. The wiring builds an `AdapterRegistry` instance at sync time (registry is empty in this task; future adapter tasks add registration calls).
11. `pnpm skills-sync` writes the inaugural file to disk; `pnpm skills-sync:check` reports `in sync` after.
12. `pnpm --filter @stageflip/skills-sync test` passes with **≥85% coverage on `asset-providers-gen.ts`**.
13. `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm check-licenses && pnpm check-asset-licenses && pnpm check-remotion-imports && pnpm check-determinism && pnpm check-skill-drift && pnpm gen:tool-skills:check` all green.
14. A lowercase changeset at `.changeset/t-424-asset-providers-catalog.md` declares a `minor` bump on `@stageflip/skills-sync`.

## Workflow

1. Branch from `origin/main`. Spec → `docs/tasks/T-424.md`. Commit.
2. Test-first: write `packages/skills-sync/src/asset-providers-gen.test.ts` covering AC #1–#9 (mock adapter rows → expected markdown). Tests fail. Commit.
3. Implement `asset-providers-gen.ts` + re-export. Wire into `scripts/sync-skills.ts`. Add `@stageflip/adapters-core` to `packages/skills-sync/package.json` deps. Commit `feat(skills-sync): T-424 — reference/asset-providers auto-gen catalog`.
4. `pnpm install` (workspace link picks up the new dep) → `pnpm --filter @stageflip/skills-sync build` → `pnpm skills-sync` → commit the inaugural empty-state SKILL.md (and any incidental drift in the existing six auto-gens, if it surfaces — pre-empts the skills-sync drift lesson).
5. Add lowercase changeset.
